narr: Thunderstorms formed along a slow-moving cold front in Central Texas and moved through South-Central Texas. The slow movement led to high rainfall rates and locally heavy rain which in turn led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. There were multiple stranded vehicles and high water rescues reported across San Antonio.
